incident: The first ad hoc release invocation omitted deferRasterToActions and generated local raster evidence before the configuration correction was reviewed.
rootCause: The wrapper release override called buildOfficial with a temporary config that did not carry the host's deferred-raster requirement; the host family configuration also still had the stale STOP/custom vehicle during the initial check.
correction: The exact noncustodial config now declares BUILD, official-pdf-fill, the official output path, and deferRasterToActions=true. The custodial config was restored to its prior value.
remainingBlocker: The existing product-wiring record is still under the old custom-pleading path, so --check refuses deterministic wiring drift until the owner-directed FIX02 wiring update is applied.
